evals.prompt: 我现在想做一个小红书的博主数据采集工作流，跟之前抖音那个类似。我需要抓取博主信息、所有笔记、如果是图文就做OCR、视频就转文字、然后打标签出报告。帮我设计这个工作流应该分成哪些skill，怎么编排。
evals.expected_output: A workflow design that separates reusable capabilities from Xiaohongshu-specific capabilities and provides explicit orchestration contracts.
assertions: Identifies reusable atomic skills such as OCR, transcription, polishing, tagging, or reporting.
Identifies Xiaohongshu-specific skills such as author parsing and note collection.
Provides a step-by-step orchestration flow with explicit input and output handoffs.
Includes checkpoints or fallback behavior for failure-prone steps.

evals.prompt: We have one giant customer-document intake skill. It downloads email attachments, virus-scans them, OCRs PDFs, extracts invoice fields, sends uncertain fields to a reviewer, writes records to our accounting API, and posts a Slack summary. Changing OCR behavior keeps breaking the accounting step. Refactor this into a maintainable skill architecture. We need safe retries because the workflow can resume after a crash.
evals.expected_output: A generalized refactor plan with coherent atomic boundaries, a thin orchestrator, explicit contracts, human review, and resumable failure handling.
assertions: Separates download, scan, OCR, extraction, review, accounting write, and notification responsibilities into coherent atomic boundaries.
Keeps business implementation details out of the orchestration flow.
Includes a STOP checkpoint for uncertain fields that require reviewer confirmation.
Defines retry, idempotency, or resume-state guidance for crash recovery.

evals.prompt: Design a release workflow skill for our web app. It should run tests and a build in parallel, stop if either fails, deploy to staging, run smoke checks, wait for human approval, deploy production, and post a release note. Please avoid splitting every shell command into its own skill.
evals.expected_output: A practical release workflow architecture that uses stable atomic boundaries, parallel routing, an approval stop, and avoids microscopic wrapper skills.
assertions: Models tests and build as parallelizable work before staging deployment.
Includes an explicit stop when tests, build, or smoke checks fail.
Includes a STOP checkpoint for human production approval.
Avoids proposing a separate skill for every shell command and explains sensible grouping.
